About

The accountant who thinks
like a strategist.

I'm a Senior Accountant at CVM & Associates, a Chartered Accountant firm in Delhi, where I manage end-to-end financial operations for a diverse portfolio of over 50 corporate and non-corporate clients.

My practice spans the full breadth of financial accounting — from ledger scrutiny and year-end closings to GST return filings and TDS compliance. I bring particular depth to FMCG co-operative accounting, having built automated Excel frameworks for Gujarat Cooperative Milk Marketing Federation (Amul).

Beyond compliance, I focus on building systems that improve accuracy and reduce processing time. My custom Excel templates have reduced monthly data processing time by 40%, and I've maintained a 100% on-time filing record across all client entities.
